title: Price all 153 pairwise BIT body-axis overlaps under the fixed caller
body:
One common body coordinate cancels in the product of physical partial swaps. Every one of the 153 fixed-coordinate stage pairs has negative full signed change at both trial κ values. The stage 9/10 example keeps paid ranks and loses two productive grades on 222 roots, with a complete signed loss greater than 434.05 units.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. This changes stage coordinates instead of the #7887 packet grouping. The relocated python3 -I -B check.py replay reproduces the census and exact 9/10 operator in both directions and rejects a union-selector mutation and changed source. OpenAI Codex assisted. Retained authors credited.

## Open next questions

Oblique or noncommuting selectors, multiple overlaps and a changed physical supplier remain open.
